meta.title: UniqueGroupsView

fields.name: groupId
fields.mapping: Signal Captured.groupId — empty/absent represents the permanent 'None' row

fields.name: groupName
fields.mapping: GroupsView.name (looked up by groupId), or literally 'None' when groupId is empty

fields.name: assignedProject
fields.mapping: latest:Signal Assigned To Project.projectId for this groupId's most recent signal

meta.description: One row per distinct groupId, PLUS a permanent 'None' row aggregating every signal with no group (a direct message). Folds Signal Captured (to aggregate and resolve the display name) and Signal Assigned To Project (for the current project badge). Powers the Signals screen's 'Group' grouping mode. Never keys or dedupes on groupName — only groupId, since two distinct groups can share a display name (the 'None' row is the one exception, since it has no real groupId at all).
